column8: Sun 22 Nov: 2.0 and 3c, the prospectus line D2 quotes beside the 0.5% margin; the 27 Feb 2026 edition repeats Q16-001 word for word and the product page's 'not predictable' is already in Q3a-025 (merged there), so this confirms the head row.

Sun 22 Nov: store; the fund's final cash earns money-market rates, which can only lift the payout above the zero-interest count; no figure, and the waiver can end by agreement.

Sun 22 Nov: 2.0, no promise sits on the share; the product-page line is already in Q3a-025, merged into Q16-001.

Sun 22 Nov: 3c and 3e, the sponsor's own words for the risk Trading Note 2 called 'not fixed', which the zero-interest count answers (ATTACKS D2's three answers); one clause at most, beside the count, not as a new risk.

Sun 22 Nov: 3c note or Table 1 note, the rule's holdings (4.25% coupons) are the cautious choice against IBTM's real 3.50%; the 0.11% to 0.51% matches NUMBERS 3; dated 27 Oct, turnover will change it.

Sun 22 Nov: 3c and 3e, the Treasuries inside the late-2032 fund change while their year does not; quote only the prospectus's 70% (the four-year row label is Keel's reading); say it plainly, never as a gloss on ink (ink is a figure Treasuries held for her will pay).
Sun 22 Nov: store, input to rows 13-16; the new-issue sentence is read in sibling IBTH's prospectus only, so never quote it as IBTM's.
Sun 22 Nov: store, textbook auction calendar, input to row 13 only.

Sun 22 Nov: store until NUMBERS 3 has a turnover test. Fix: the 0.06%/0.39%/1.8% are illustrative Keel arithmetic, never in prose; say 'the top would not be fully paid at zero interest', never 'not owned'; the 0.31% of house paths is rarer than 1 in 100, never in prose.
Sun 22 Nov: Table 3 row 4's note only, the yearly read of holdings may see swaps in 2027, 2029 and 2030; an inference from two figures and the calendar, never stated as a forecast.

Sun 22 Nov: 3c, pedigree for why the range rule measures each end once, on the trade day, on cautious holdings with a margin: the plan does the escrow verifier's job itself; a clause, never 3c's outside parallel (the RBA holds that slot, D6).

Sun 22 Nov: 2.0 beside the fund rows, one clause at most: Ginnie Mae puts the US promise on the security, an iBonds fund keeps it on the Treasuries inside, so 'guaranteed' goes on the Treasuries (D2); competes with 2.0's budget (deletion test, LDI, ink), not in ARGUMENT_TREE, so the writers' call.
Sun 22 Nov: store, inside 3e's first item (lending is a cost-or-income line, the margin's job); the terms are new beside Q26-015.
Sun 22 Nov: store; borrowers indemnified, collateral not; never say a payment rests on BlackRock's indemnity (IPS l.11, anybody else's money); IBTM had nothing on loan at 31 Oct 2025.
Sun 22 Nov: store; for IBTQ the collateral sits in a Treasury money fund, so AIG's 2008 mode (Q65-031) is not the set-up; seen for IBTQ only, the agreement allows the prime fund.

Sun 22 Nov: Table 3's note or 3e, against bond attack 24. Fix: drop the ratio (Keel arithmetic; the card says 3 to 15 and 3 to 25); say 'each payment fund held more than $100 million in November 2026, against $25.8m and $33.9m for the only two term ETFs ended months early', dated, since size can fall near the end.
Sun 22 Nov: store only. Fix: the per-fund ratios are Keel arithmetic not in NUMBERS (only IBTM's 1 dollar in 4,600 is, 8w); never in prose unless the numbers owner adds them.
Sun 22 Nov: 3e, answers attack 24's rising-rate point; IBTA's near-zero last year is already Q3c-016.

Sun 22 Nov: 3e only if ratings come up; source of D20's 'none of the three largest rating agencies rates the US AAA' and the correction to H3-088; no plan figure uses a rating; DBRS's issuer page shows a conflicting line, so cite the 18 Sep 2026 release.

Sun 22 Nov: store, a process lesson: H3-088 copied a wire story's scope; check the fourth agency before writing 'anywhere'.

Fix: open 'Each share of a Treasury fund' (never 'iBonds share' at first mention: a fund is not a bond, WORDS) and add 'less the 0.5% margin' after the fund's fee, so it matches D2's ink; keep 'holds', never 'only'.

Sun 22 Nov: 3e, the one complete list of how a fund can pay less than its Treasuries. Fix: item 2 (the fund trading its Treasuries for newer ones of the same year) carries no figure until NUMBERS 3 adds a turnover test (only the par-bond stand-in is there); the margin pays item 1 only; this adds a fourth way to D2's and ARGUMENT_TREE 3e's three.

Sun 22 Nov: 3c and 3e, three answers to the TNA's 'not fixed': the zero-interest count (cash rates), the margin (costs), Table 3 row 4 and today's market rates (an early end). Fix: drop 'about 4% of the top' (Keel arithmetic); say 'at most $4,589 if cash waiting earned nothing, more than the room under the top, met from her flexibility' (NUMBERS 3, D2).

Sun 22 Nov: 3c, the rule sentence: each end is measured once, on its trade day (the bottom January 2028, the top at the move), never re-measured; D2 already struck FACTS_PLAIN's 'does not change after that' and v3 no longer carries it.

Sun 22 Nov: 2.0, the definition at first use. Fix: drop 'owned in Treasuries' for ink; use ARGUMENT_TREE 2.0's form, a figure is in ink once Treasuries held for her, directly or through Treasury funds, will pay it on its date, at zero further interest, after the 0.5% margin (D2; never 'a figure owned').

Sun 22 Nov: 3e, said once: the 200,000-path house model has no fund events, and the register sizes an early end at every month after the move and tests other holdings and frictions up to 1% (NUMBERS 3); refines D2's and ARGUMENT_TREE l.241's 'the model contains no fund events'.
Sun 22 Nov: store, input to row 11 (a one-year level assumes a refill within six months); never in 3f (D16).

Sun 22 Nov: store, the answer to the professor if asked. Fix: $87,750 against $7,736 is Keel arithmetic, not a standard-formula run and not in NUMBERS; never in 3f (no outside threshold, D16).

Sun 22 Nov: store; Basel's quotes are Q74-018 and Q74-019, and the six-year 99.4% is already in Q120-025.

Sun 22 Nov: store; the 5% exhaustion test is H3-066 (and H5-059); the added point, that it protects the charity, is a clause in the note column, not a new idea.
Sun 22 Nov: store; the IRS offered a rule in place of a probability; no outside parallel in 3f, and 3a's slot is the lottery rule.
Sun 22 Nov: store; insurers' CTE levels are argued for stability, chosen not found.

Sun 22 Nov: store only. Fix: the 9.0% rests on Keel's own tie rule, never a register figure and never in prose.
